Dev-only transitive dep (ajv 6.15.0 via eslint 8, which pins ajv ^6.12.4). CVE-2025-69873 is a ReDoS only reachable when the $data option is enabled; eslint's config-schema validation does not use $data, so it is not exploitable in this context. No safe ajv 6.x exists (advisory covers through 8.17.1); upgrading eslint to 9 (ajv 8) is a tracked follow-up.
